title: Week 8 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “principal”?
options: A pooled investment fund whose shares trade on an exchange.
Evaluation of a plan under adverse changes in income, cost, rates, or emergencies.
Assets minus liabilities at a point in time.
The amount borrowed or remaining loan balance before interest and fees.
questions.explanation: Principal means the amount borrowed or remaining loan balance before interest and fees.
choices: A pooled investment fund whose shares trade on an exchange.
